messages:
maria: Quick shippable question — uploaded a tiny prototype (figma + staging). Need opinions on streaming UI: should the primary action while streaming be 'Stop' (kills + finalizes) or 'Pause' (pausable/resumable)? Also where to put the token counter — top-right global header or inline under the last message? https://figma.com/some-link :eyes: devin: I think primary should be an inline action next to the stream (left of tokens). Accessibility first: keyboard focus + aria-pressed state. 'Pause' makes sense for resumable flows, but clarify in microcopy what happens when you press it. sam: vote for inline under-message token counter. Global header hides context. Also think about hiding exact token numbers by default for privacy (show estimate or on-hover). Copy: 'Stop' vs 'Pause' — 'Stop' feels terminal, 'Pause' feels reversible. I'd use 'Pause' during streaming and change to 'Stop' for final cancel? elaine: a11y nit: when streaming updates are appended, mark the chat container with `aria-live` (polite or assertive depending on severity) so screen readers don't spam users. Also ensure any status text (Pausing / Resuming) is announced. jon: UX note — regenerate should be debounced and represented inline (e.g., overlay over the message: 'Regenerating…' + spinner) rather than creating a new message node. Also prevent rapid double-clicks (300ms debounce) and show a clear keyboard shortcut if possible. maria: ok good. I'm leaning toward 'Pause' as the primary during stream (to make it clear it's reversible) and expose a secondary 'Stop' only on the message overflow menu for hard cancel. Token counter inline but collapsed by default, expand on hover or with keyboard focus. devin: snippet for aria-live we can add to the prototype:```html
``` Also set `aria-busy="true"` while streaming and `false` when done so AT knows state. sam: copy tweak: Tooltip for token counter should read: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)". Button tooltip for primary action: use 'Pause generation (keyboard: Esc)' rather than just 'Pause'. Small change but reduces confusion. elaine: keyboard nits — propose `Esc` = stop/pause when focus is in chat, and `/` to jump to prompt. When a stream is paused, focus should move to the paused message actions so keyboard users can Resume easily. Also ensure focus ring visible on the token counter control. ux-bot: Quick accessibility checklist: :white_check_mark: aria-live implemented, :white_check_mark: keyboard shortcuts documented, :white_check_mark: focus management defined, :white_check_mark: tooltips readable by AT, :white_check_mark: contrast for icons. maria: action items — @devin please wire aria-live + aria-busy states and implement Pause/Resume states in the prototype, @sam move token counter inline and update tooltip copy, @elaine add keyboard bindings and focus rules to the accessibility doc. I'll update the Figma with two variants (inline counter collapsed vs expanded and Pause primary vs Stop primary) by EOD and post the link. Figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder ops-bot: Preview deployed to staging: https://playground.staging.redwood/preview/stream-ui-qa-45 (expires in 72h) maria: thanks all — will follow up with a short user-study plan for 5 internal folks to validate which microcopy reduces confusion. :thumbsup:
